newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: UNICORN IN MOZAMBIQUE SHIPPING LINE VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: UNICORN IN MOZAMBIQUE SHIPPING LINE VENTURE.

text.p: A joint venture between South Africa's Unicorn Lines and Portugual's Tertir will introduce a new shipping line service along Mozambique's coast in May, Unicorn Chief Executive Dave Rennie said on Monday.

The service, known as Mozline, will serve Maputo, Beira, Quelimane, Nacala and Pemba on two different port rotation schedules and offer line-owned container equipment for container and general cargo services, Rennie said.
"King and Sons, Maputo, will provide a complete shipping agency service in all major Mozambican ports, while Unicorn SA will act as agents in Durban," he said in a statement.

"By extending the through bill service to Durban, a gateway to a worldwide service into and out of Mozambique will be opened. This can only be beneficial in facilitating trade opportunities developing from a growing Mozambican economy," he added.
The first vessel dedicated to the service, called the Point Lisas, will call at Maputo during the second week of May to commence the first voyage.
The 3,000 dwt vessel is capable of carrying 158 containers and is fitted with two 25 tonne combination cranes. More ships will be added to the service later in the year.
Unicorn is a unit of Grindrod Unicorn Group Ltd.
